name: Attendance Request Routing
subject: Attendance Request requires action
message:
Attendance Request {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.employee_name }} is now in {{ doc.workflow_state }}.

Period: {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}
Reason: {{ doc.reason or '-' }}

Please review and take the next action in the workflow.

name: Attendance Request Outcome
condition: doc.workflow_state in ["Approved by HR", "Rejected by TL"]
subject: Attendance Request {{ doc.name }} - {{ doc.workflow_state }}
message:
Your Attendance Request {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.employee_name }} has been moved to {{ doc.workflow_state }}.

Period: {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}
Reason: {{ doc.reason or '-' }}

Please log in to review the latest status.

name: Leave Application Outcome
